column1: # VERIFICATION_STATUS: N/A (this IS the verification record)
# PURPOSE (DDC-14): the typed test/verification status of every claim/feature. Replaces a single
#   linear "done-ness" scale with FOUR ORTHOGONAL dimensions (ratified D4) so "written" can never be
# D4 STATUS LATTICE — NO cross-inference between dimensions; DEFAULT ATTEMPTED_UNTESTED for any new claim:
#   implementation : proposed -> designed -> written -> included -> wired
#   RULE: "written" != "active" != "effective" != "approved". A claim advances one axis at a time,
#         each advance evidenced. Never infer execution/validation from implementation.
#   - every row carries all four dimension values (fail on a missing axis)
#   - no row asserts validation=measured-effective without an evidence pointer (fail-closed)
#   - default of a newly-added row is implementation=written or lower, others at floor
#   - governance=owner-approved-for-promotion requires a DDC-11 decision id
#   - claims marked effective cross-link the DDC-15 provenance of the evidence
# ## STATE face — current status per claim (supersede a row in place when a dimension advances)
# ## HISTORY face — append-only advance log (never edit past rows; newest first)
